journey.name: TL-19 A task created under an active query lands where the user cannot see it
journey.description:
KNOWN-DEFECT WATCHLIST. Asserts the current behaviour; whether it is the right behaviour is a product call. See qa/TEST-PLAN.md.
The query lives in the list state and nothing clears it on the way back from a save, so a new task whose title does not match the live filter is created, cached, and invisible. The user saw the editor close, which is the app's only signal that a save worked, and then saw a list that does not contain what they just typed - the same picture a failed save would paint, except that this one succeeded.
The route back exists, and this journey ends by taking it: Clear search brings the task into view. The finding is that nothing points the user at it.
A search field is also the most likely place to arrive from: typing a title, finding it is not there, and tapping plus is a normal way to add a task.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Type "invoice" into the "Search by title" field
Verify that the text “No tasks match “invoice”.” is on screen
Tap the element with the content description "Add task"
Verify that the app returns to the "Tasks" screen
Verify that "Bought milk" is not on screen
Verify that the text “No tasks match “invoice”.” is on screen
Verify that the "Search by title" field still contains "invoice"
Tap the element with the content description "Clear search"
Verify that "Bought milk" is on screen
Verify that "Bought milk" is the last row in the list
